As Mondelez International (MDLZ) Market Valuation Declined, Mar Vista Investment Partners Lowered by $1.42 Million Its Stake; Green Brick Partners (GRBK) Valuation Declined While Punch & Associates Investment Management Has Increased Holding by $1.32 Million 
April 15, 2018 - By Darrin Black 
Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc decreased its stake in Mondelez International Inc (MDLZ) by 2.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc sold 33,799 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.65% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.38M shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $58.91M, down from 1.41 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc who had been investing in Mondelez International Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $62.43B market cap company. The stock increased 0.14% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $42.09. About 5.33 million shares traded. Mondelez International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) has declined 6.02% since April 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.57% the S&P500. 
Punch & Associates Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Green Brick Partners Inc (GRBK) by 8.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Punch & Associates Investment Management Inc bought 119,669 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.44% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.54 million shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.38M, up from 1.42M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Punch & Associates Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Green Brick Partners Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $531.29M market cap company. The stock increased 0.96% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $10.5. About 12,801 shares traded. Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) has risen 3.52% since April 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.03% the S&P500. 
Analysts await Mondelez International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $0.61 EPS, up 15.09% or $0.08 from last year’s $0.53 per share. MDLZ’s profit will be $904.77M for 17.25 P/E if the $0.61 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.57 actual EPS reported by Mondelez International, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 7.02% EPS growth. 
Among 23 analysts covering Mondelez International Inc ( NASDAQ:MDLZ ), 18 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 78% are positive. Mondelez International Inc had 61 analyst reports since July 31, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was maintained on Thursday, February 1 by Bank of America. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, September 6 by JP Morgan. As per Monday, October 23, the company rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus. The firm has “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets given on Thursday, February 1. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Monday, September 18 by Piper Jaffray. UBS maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, October 13 report. The rating was downgraded by Credit Agricole on Thursday, August 6 to “Outperform”. RBC Capital Markets maintained Mondelez International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MDLZ) rating on Thursday, April 28. RBC Capital Markets has “Outperform” rating and $52 target. Stifel Nicolaus maintained it with “Hold” rating and $4500 target in Friday, July 7 report. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, January 19 by Credit Suisse. 
Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc, which manages about $1.80B and $2.67 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) by 2,289 shares to 390,613 shares, valued at $54.58M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,071 shares in the quarter, for a total of 356,326 shares, and has risen its stake in Pepsico Inc (NYSE:PEP).
